profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Netflix
profile.geoLocationName: Santa Barbara County, California, United States
profile.summary: Senior Engineer with experience developing, delivering, and maintaining a diverse array of infrastructure for high availability and optimum performance. Extensive experience optimizing a global suite of applications in Ruby/Rails/Postgres that serves millions of users worldwide. Deep technical troubleshooting skills and knowledge of system internals, as well as best-practice application development methodologies.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented solution to relieve pressure on an overloaded production Postgres database that routinely processes 30k transactions per second. Created a tool to mitigate the primary source of application downtime, and implemented a longer term fix through a combination of infrastructure and application level changes. Able to go from idea to prototype to production solution in just under three weeks, successfully preventing performance crises.

Key contributor on a move from a thick server infrastructure to a fully containerized, auto-scaling architecture. The impact of this project was to save Procore hosting money, improve our security posture, and pave the way for the adoption of container technologies and immutable infrastructure organizationally. Orchestrated an accelerated delivery of this project to remediate an extremely impactful incident where we lost the ability to deploy code changes to production. These projects all required multi-squad collaboration within the infrastructure tribe and across R&D. 

Launched the organization's first successful production-grade microservices in Kubernetes and paved the way for further adoption to solve some of the company's scaling issues.

Identified a file storage inefficiency and implemented a file storage optimization plan that reduced our AWS S3 yearly costs by over $1 million annually (roughly 40% of total S3 costs).

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Led multiple efforts to break apart monolithic application into independently scalable and regionally supportable microservices in order to better support our global customers and continue to meet scaling demands.

Developed, validated, and implemented a strategy for migrating a 20 TB database from open stack private cloud to AWS Aurora. Implementation included a rollback strategy and the need to run parallel systems while validating the compatibility of the new AWS infrastructure. Migration was completed with minimal customer impact. 

Spearheaded disaster recovery plan post migration to Aurora. This included development, technical implementation, validation, and testing. Led DR drills to validate we could comply with our MSA. This allowed us to cancel the Rackspace contract on time, saving multiple millions of dollars.

Led a group of in copying Procore's primary production S3 bucket into a new AWS account to improve data resiliency. After researching and testing numerous potential solutions, developed a repeatable process that ensured maximal data integrity and required minimal human toil. As a result, the 3.5 petabytes (and growing) of files that clients relied on were replicated across multiple AWS regions.

Worked with application developers and product managers to design the infrastructure to support a new product on a tight deadline. The product was successfully launched in time for Procore's annual user conference.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Initiated deep dive investigation into the cause of application queuing and implemented a fix that reduced boot times to 4 minutes from 10 minutes. This fix resulted in a 60% reduction in average code deployment times.

Evangelized use of available application performance tools such as NewRelic, DataDog, Scout, and SumoLogic for their utility in reducing time to resolve incidents or preventing them altogether through proactive alerting policies.

Self-direction exploration of our infrastructure led to discovery of multiple severe platform issues including our production database being critically low on remaining transaction IDs. If this issue had not been caught and mitigated we would have suffered extended downtime within 24 hours. 

Led a project to identify and send traffic to a read-only database cluster using a reverse proxy. The work alleviated performance disruptions at peak load and prevented significant customer impact, allowing us to achieve 99.985% ping uptime for the calendar year.

Working closely with R&D stakeholders and product managers, participated in the launch of a new squad utilizing machine learning to develop new tools to provide insights into our clients' data and behaviors. 

Appointed as an inaugural member of Procore's Engineering Advisory Council and used that role to encourage additional clarity on how R&D's long-term goals align with quarterly revenue goals.

Developed and instructed a well-received analytics DevAcademy course and follow-up sessions that increased squads' understanding of newly implemented performance metrics and provided tools so they could better meet their performance budgets.

Completed "Teach Kids Programming" training sessions and participated in corresponding volunteer opportunities with local Girls Inc. students.
